about_the_game:
Operation: Overlord DLC

Storm the beaches and liberate occupied territory in the Operation: Overlord DLC for Operation: Harsh Doorstop. Relive the legendary events of D-Day, as Allied forces launch the largest amphibious invasion in history, fighting to establish a foothold in Normandy and push back the Axis war machine.

From the chaos of the beach landings to fierce battles in the hedgerows, Operation: Overlord delivers an unforgettable World War II experience where teamwork and tactics are essential to victory.

Key Features:

  • 🌊 Historic D-Day Invasion:
    Assault the fortified beaches of Normandy in a detailed recreation of the June 6th, 1944 landings. Advance through coastal defenses, secure critical objectives, and push inland through deadly, fortified territory.

  • 🪖 Authentic Weapons and Factions:
    Deploy as Allied invasion forces or Axis defenders, equipped with period-accurate gear like M1 Garands, Thompsons, MG42s, Kar98ks, and more.

  • 🎯 Exclusive Dynamic Campaign Mode:
    Fight across a living frontline where your team's performance shapes the course of the invasion. Whether playing solo, in co-op, or multiplayer, the battlefield evolves with each victory and defeat as you fight to liberate—or hold—Normandy.

History’s Most Iconic Invasion.

The Operation: Overlord DLC brings the brutal, high-stakes combat of D-Day to Operation: Harsh Doorstop. Whether you're storming the beaches under heavy fire or mounting a desperate defense from entrenched positions, every moment is a fight for history.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 270X (or equivalent with at least 2 GB of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Purchase this DLC to get access to the entire Operation: Overlord campaign. This campaign includes a variety of new weapons, vehicles, factions, and modes set during the invasion of Normandy in World War II.
